discovery.note: Platform, target, namespace, region, ASG and cloud account are discovered at run time by matching the service name against the knowledge graph. Anything listed under `services` below overrides what discovery returns.

billing-service.reason: Runs as a systemd unit on a VM. Discovery would otherwise resolve it to the Kubernetes workload of the same name.

cloud.note: `aws` is the value the resolver emits for this platform; the plugin directory is named `cloud` to match the source playbook layout.
